description: This file defines a BroadcastReceiver subclass that handles media button actions, routing them to a specific activity for further processing.

classes.name: SampleMediaButtonReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver for media button intents, facilitating communication between media key events and the main activity.

methods.name: setActivity
methods.description: Sets the static reference to MainActivity to route media key events.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Receives media button broadcast intents and forwards the key event to MainActivity if available.
